g.title: key
g.text: reads raw files only — can run in any order
reads the merged graph, so it runs after pass 1
nodes.jsonl, edges.jsonl and a MANIFEST that fingerprints both
writes a stamped artifact, never a claim
answers from the release, refuses past it

12 of 13 declared layers are in this release (absent: curated). Merge order is LAYER_PRECEDENCE: spine → host → vhppi → orcs → curated → chembl → selectivity → gtop → hosttargets → similarity → ncats → indications → folds.
